```{r}
data_raw <- read_excel("mole crabs fixed swash and temp.xlsx") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    water_temp = as.numeric(str_extract(water_temp, "[0-9.]+")),
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = factor(year(date))
  )
```

```{r}
clean_data <- data_raw %>%
  mutate(

    # ===========================
    # STANDARDIZE LOCATION
    # ===========================
    location = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(location), "brighton|bluff") ~ "bluffs",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "south bath|bath ave") ~ "south_bath",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "deal|allenhurst|roosevelt") ~ "deal",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "ocean grove") ~ "ocean_grove",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "sandy hook") ~ "sandy_hook",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN WAVES
    # ===========================
    waves_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "small|\\bsm\\b") ~ "Small",
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "med") ~ "Medium",
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "large|rough|3-5") ~ "Large",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN ZONE
    # ===========================
    zone = tolower(zone),
    zone = case_when(
      str_detect(zone, "bore")  ~ "bore",
      str_detect(zone, "swash|surf") ~ "swash",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN ENVIRONMENTAL NUMERIC VARIABLES
    # ===========================
    salinity = as.numeric(str_extract(salinity, "[0-9.]+")),
    do_mg_l_raw = as.numeric(str_extract(do_mg_l, "[0-9.]+")),
    air_temp_deg_c = as.numeric(str_extract(air_temp_deg_c, "[0-9.]+")),

    # ===========================
    # FIX DO
    # ===========================
    do_mg_l = case_when(
      do_mg_l_raw > 20 ~ NA_real_,
      do_mg_l_raw <= 0 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ do_mg_l_raw
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN MOON PHASE
    # ===========================
    moon_phase_clean = tolower(moon_phase),
    moon_phase_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "full") ~ "Full",
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "first|waxing") ~ "Waxing",
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "last|waning") ~ "Waning",
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "quarter|quater") ~ "Quarter",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN TIDE STAGE
    # ===========================
    tide_clean = tolower(tide_stage),
    tide_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(tide_clean, "high") ~ "High",
      str_detect(tide_clean, "low|\\bl\\b") ~ "Low",
      str_detect(tide_clean, "rising|flood|incoming") ~ "Rising",
      str_detect(tide_clean, "falling|ebb") ~ "Falling",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN SKY
    # ===========================
    sky_clean = tolower(sky),
    sky_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(sky_clean, "clear|sun") ~ "Clear",
      str_detect(sky_clean, "part") ~ "Partly Cloudy",
      str_detect(sky_clean, "cloud") ~ "Cloudy",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN FOAM
    # ===========================
    foam_clean = tolower(foam_floatables_y_n),
    foam_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(foam_clean, "y|foam") ~ "Foam",
      str_detect(foam_clean, "n|none|little") ~ "No Foam",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN WATER CLARITY
    # ===========================
    water_clean = tolower(water_color_transparency),
    water_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(water_clean, "clear|transparent|high transparency") ~ "Clear",
      str_detect(water_clean, "murky|low transparency|dark|brown|grey|cloudy") ~ "Murky",
      str_detect(water_clean, "green|olive|yellow|blue") ~ "Moderate",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%

  # Remove helper column
  dplyr::select(-do_mg_l_raw) %>%

  # Keep valid locations only
  filter(!is.na(location)) %>%

  mutate(
    location = factor(location),
    year = factor(year, levels = sort(unique(year))),
    waves_clean = factor(waves_clean, levels = c("Small","Medium","Large")),
    zone = factor(zone, levels = c("bore","swash")),
    moon_phase_clean = factor(moon_phase_clean,
                              levels = c("Waxing","Full","Waning","Quarter")),
    tide_clean = factor(tide_clean,
                        levels = c("Low","Rising","High","Falling")),
    sky_clean = factor(sky_clean,
                       levels = c("Clear","Partly Cloudy","Cloudy")),
    foam_clean = factor(foam_clean,
                        levels = c("No Foam","Foam")),
    water_clean = factor(water_clean,
                         levels = c("Clear","Moderate","Murky"))
  ) %>%

  droplevels()
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# CREATE LONG FORMAT SIZE DATA
# ----------------------------------

temp_mean <- mean(clean_data$water_temp, na.rm = TRUE)

size_data <- clean_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    date,
    water_temp,
    salinity,
    do_mg_l,
    air_temp_deg_c,
    waves_clean,
    location,
    year,
    zone,
    groin,            
    scoops,
    ct_2mm, ct_6mm, ct_12mm
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    ct_2mm  = as.numeric(ct_2mm),
    ct_6mm  = as.numeric(ct_6mm),
    ct_12mm = as.numeric(ct_12mm),
    
    # Clean  
    groin = case_when(
      groin %in% c("N","n") ~ "North",
      groin %in% c("S","s") ~ "South",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ct_2mm, ct_6mm, ct_12mm),
    names_to = "size_class",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    size_class = factor(
      size_class,
      levels = c("ct_2mm","ct_6mm","ct_12mm"),
      labels = c("Small (2mm)",
                 "Medium (6mm)",
                 "Large (12mm+)")
    ),
    
    water_temp_c = water_temp - temp_mean,
    
    count = ifelse(is.na(count), 0, count),
    
    zone = factor(zone, levels = c("bore","swash")),
    groin = factor(groin, levels = c("North","South"))
  ) %>%
  
  droplevels()
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# MORE DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS
# ==========================================

size_data <- size_data %>%
  mutate(
    nourishment_period = case_when(
      year %in% c("2020","2021","2022","2023") ~ "Before",
      year %in% c("2024","2025") ~ "After"
    ),
    nourishment_period = factor(nourishment_period,
                                levels = c("Before","After"))
  )

# ----------------------------------
# Zero Proportion by Year
# ----------------------------------

zero_year <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    zero_prop = mean(count == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_count = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

print(zero_year)

# ----------------------------------
# Before vs After Summary
# ----------------------------------

before_after <- size_data %>%
  group_by(nourishment_period) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_count = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_count = median(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    zero_prop = mean(count == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_count = sd(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

print(before_after)

# ----------------------------------
# Coefficient of Variation by Size Class
# ----------------------------------

cv_table <- size_data %>%
  group_by(size_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    CV = sd / mean
  )

print(cv_table)

# ----------------------------------
# Quartiles by Year
# ----------------------------------

quartiles_year <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    q25 = quantile(count, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(count, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(quartiles_year)

# ----------------------------------
# Observed 2024 Decline
# ----------------------------------

decline_table <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(mean_count = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2024")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year,
              values_from = mean_count)

decline <- 1 - (decline_table$`2024` /
                decline_table$`2021`)

cat("Observed 2024 decline:",
    round(decline * 100, 1), "%\n")

# ----------------------------------
# Spatial Heterogeneity
# ----------------------------------

spatial_summary <- size_data %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_count = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    zero_prop = mean(count == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

print(spatial_summary)

# ----------------------------------
# Dispersion Metrics (NB Justification)
# ----------------------------------

mean_count <- mean(size_data$count, na.rm = TRUE)
var_count  <- var(size_data$count, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Overall mean:", mean_count, "\n")
cat("Overall variance:", var_count, "\n")
cat("Variance-to-Mean ratio:",
    var_count / mean_count, "\n")
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------------------

site_summary <- size_data %>%

# ----------------------------------

site_coords <- data.frame(
  location = c("sandy_hook","bluffs","south_bath","deal","ocean_grove"),
  lat = c(40.445, 40.300, 40.292, 40.245, 40.210),
  lon = c(-73.990, -74.000, -74.003, -74.025, -74.010)
)

site_summary <- left_join(site_summary, site_coords, by = "location")

# Clean labels
site_summary$location_clean <- dplyr::recode(site_summary$location,
  sandy_hook  = "Sandy Hook",
  bluffs      = "Bluffs",
  south_bath  = "South Bath",
  deal        = "Deal",
  ocean_grove = "Ocean Grove"
)

# ----------------------------------
# Label positioning (original spacing)
# ----------------------------------

site_summary <- site_summary %>%
  mutate(
    label_lon = lon - 0.025,
    label_lat = case_when(
      location == "sandy_hook" ~ lat + 0.01,
      location == "bluffs" ~ lat + 0.010,
      location == "south_bath" ~ lat - 0.010,
      location == "deal" ~ lat - 0.005,
      location == "ocean_grove" ~ lat - 0.008,
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# OBSERVED TEMPORAL TREND
# ----------------------------------

raw_year <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year, size_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_count = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(count, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---- Compute TOTAL decline ----
raw_total <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(mean_total = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE))

decline_percent <-
  (1 - raw_total$mean_total[raw_total$year == "2024"] /
        raw_total$mean_total[raw_total$year == "2021"]) * 100

decline_label <- paste0("~", round(decline_percent,0),
                        "% decline across size classes")

ggplot() +
  
  # ---- Raw data points (jittered) ----
  geom_jitter(
    data = size_data,
    aes(x = year,
        y = count + 0.1,  # small offset to avoid log(0)
        color = size_class),
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.25,
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  
  # ---- SE ribbon ----
  geom_ribbon(
    data = raw_year,
    aes(x = year,
        ymin = mean_count - se,
        ymax = mean_count + se,
        fill = size_class,
        group = size_class),
    alpha = 0.15,
    color = NA
  ) +
  
  # ---- Mean line ----
  geom_line(
    data = raw_year,
    aes(x = year,
        y = mean_count,
        color = size_class,
        group = size_class),
    linewidth = 1.6
  ) +
  
  # ---- Mean points ----
  geom_point(
    data = raw_year,
    aes(x = year,
        y = mean_count,
        color = size_class),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean Observed Abundance (log scale)",
    color = "Size Class",
    fill  = "Size Class",
    title = "Observed Temporal Trend in Mole Crab Abundance"
  )
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# OBSERVED TEMPERATURE RELATIONSHIP (WITH RAW POINTS)
# ----------------------------------

# ---- Binned summary ----
obs_temp <- size_data %>%
  mutate(temp_bin = round(water_temp * 2) / 2) %>%   # 0.5°C bins
  group_by(size_class, temp_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_count = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(count, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n >= 5)

ggplot() +
  
  # ---- Raw data points (stable version) ----
  geom_jitter(
    data = size_data,
    aes(x = water_temp,
        y = pmax(count, 0.01),   # prevents log collapse
        color = size_class),
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.25,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # ---- SE ribbon ----
  geom_ribbon(
    data = obs_temp,
    aes(x = temp_bin,
        ymin = pmax(mean_count - se, 0.01),
        ymax = mean_count + se,
        fill = size_class,
        group = size_class),
    alpha = 0.18,
    color = NA
  ) +
  
  # ---- Mean line ----
  geom_line(
    data = obs_temp,
    aes(x = temp_bin,
        y = mean_count,
        color = size_class,
        group = size_class),
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # ---- Mean points ----
  geom_point(
    data = obs_temp,
    aes(x = temp_bin,
        y = mean_count,
        color = size_class),
    size = 3
  ) +
  
  scale_y_log10(
  limits = c(0.05, 150),
  breaks = c(0.1, 1, 10, 100)
) +
  scale_color_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Water Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Mean Observed Abundance (log scale)",
    color = "Size Class",
    fill  = "Size Class",
    title = "Observed Temperature and Mole Crab Abundance"
  )
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# ZONE-SPECIFIC DEMOGRAPHIC STRUCTURE
# (Proportional Stacked)
# ==========================================

zone_data <- size_data %>%
  filter(!location %in% c("ocean_grove","sandy_hook"),
         zone %in% c("bore","swash")) %>%
  mutate(
    nourishment_period = factor(nourishment_period,
                                levels = c("Before","After")),
    zone = factor(zone,
                  levels = c("swash","bore"),
                  labels = c("Swash Zone","Bore Zone")),
    size_numeric = case_when(
      size_class == "Small (2mm)" ~ 2,
      size_class == "Medium (6mm)" ~ 6,
      size_class == "Large (12mm+)" ~ 12
    )
  )

zone_counts <- zone_data %>%
  group_by(zone, nourishment_period, size_class) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(count), .groups = "drop")

zone_summary <- zone_data %>%
  group_by(zone, nourishment_period) %>%
  summarise(
    total_n = sum(count),
    mean_size = sum(count * size_numeric) / sum(count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = nourishment_period,
              values_from = c(total_n, mean_size)) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      "n: ", total_n_Before, " → ", total_n_After,
      "   |   Mean size: ",
      round(mean_size_Before,1), " → ",
      round(mean_size_After,1), " mm"
    )
  )

ggplot(zone_counts,
       aes(x = nourishment_period,
           y = total,
           fill = size_class)) +
  
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  
  facet_wrap(~ zone, nrow = 1) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  
  geom_text(data = zone_summary,
            aes(x = 1.5,
                y = 1.05,
                label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 4,
            fontface = "bold") +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.1), clip = "off") +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 20)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Nourishment Period",
    y = "Proportion of Total Abundance",
    fill = "Size Class",
    title = "Zone-Specific Demographic Structure"
  )
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# DEMOGRAPHIC RESET – STATISTICAL TESTS
# ==========================================

cat("\n=============================\n")
cat("DEMOGRAPHIC RESET STATISTICS\n")
cat("=============================\n\n")

# ------------------------------------------
# 1️⃣ Chi-square test: 2022 vs 2025 structure
# ------------------------------------------

table_22 <- size_data %>%
  filter(year == "2022") %>%
  group_by(size_class) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pull(total)

table_25 <- size_data %>%
  filter(year == "2025") %>%
  group_by(size_class) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pull(total)

chisq_result <- chisq.test(rbind(table_22, table_25))

cat("Chi-square test (2022 vs 2025):\n")
print(chisq_result)

# Cramer's V
X2 <- chisq_result$statistic
N  <- sum(table_22) + sum(table_25)
k  <- min(length(table_22) - 1, 1)

cramers_v <- sqrt(X2 / (N * k))

cat("\nCramer's V:", round(cramers_v, 3), "\n\n")


# ------------------------------------------
# 2️⃣ Mean Body Size ANOVA
# ------------------------------------------

size_data$size_numeric <- ifelse(size_data$size_class == "Small (2mm)", 2,
                           ifelse(size_data$size_class == "Medium (6mm)", 6,
                                  12))

lm_size <- lm(size_numeric ~ year,
              data = size_data,
              weights = count)

cat("Weighted ANOVA: Mean Body Size ~ Year\n")
print(anova(lm_size))

summary_lm <- summary(lm_size)

cat("\nModel R-squared:",
    round(summary_lm$r.squared, 3), "\n\n")


# ------------------------------------------
# 3️⃣ Small:Large Ratio Test (2022 vs 2025)
# ------------------------------------------

ratio_df <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year, size_class) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = size_class,
              values_from = total)

ratio_df$ratio <- ratio_df$`Small (2mm)` /
                  ratio_df$`Large (12mm+)`

ratio_subset <- ratio_df %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2022", "2025"))

# Subset to small and large only
sl_data <- size_data %>%
  filter(size_class %in% c("Small (2mm)", "Large (12mm+)"),
         year %in% c("2022","2025"))

sl_data$small_binary <- ifelse(sl_data$size_class == "Small (2mm)", 1, 0)

glm_ratio <- glm(small_binary ~ year,
                 weights = count,
                 family = binomial,
                 data = sl_data)

summary(glm_ratio)

cat("\n=============================\n")
cat("END OF DEMOGRAPHIC TESTS\n")
cat("=============================\n")
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# CREATE MODELING DATASET
# ----------------------------------
analysis_data <- size_data %>%
  
  # Exclude control/outside site
  filter(location != "sandy_hook") %>%
  
  # Remove zero effort
  filter(scoops > 0) %>%
  
  mutate(
    # Log sampling effort as predictor (NOT offset)
    log_scoops = log(scoops),
    
    # Center date
    date_numeric = as.numeric(date),
    date_c = date_numeric - mean(date_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Center environmental predictors
    salinity_c = salinity - mean(salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    do_c = do_mg_l - mean(do_mg_l, na.rm = TRUE),
    air_temp_c = air_temp_deg_c - mean(air_temp_deg_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    zone = factor(zone, levels = c("bore","swash")),
    groin = factor(groin, levels = c("North","South"))
  ) %>%
  
  drop_na(count, scoops, size_class, location, year) %>%
  droplevels()

# Set baseline year
analysis_data$year <- relevel(analysis_data$year, ref = "2021")

```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# PRIMARY DEMOGRAPHIC MODEL
# ==========================================

nb_final <- glm.nb(
  count ~ log_scoops +
          water_temp_c * size_class +
          location * year,
  data = analysis_data,
  control = glm.control(maxit = 200)
)

summary(nb_final)
coef_table <- summary(nb_final)$coefficients
cat("\nModel AIC:", AIC(nb_final), "\n")
cat("NB theta:", nb_final$theta, "\n")
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# ENVIRONMENTAL VARIABLE SCREENING
# ==========================================

candidate_vars <- c("waves_clean",
                    "salinity",
                    "do_mg_l",
                    "air_temp_deg_c")

# Null model
nb_null <- glm.nb(
  count ~ log_scoops,
  data = analysis_data
)

for (var in candidate_vars) {

  formula_str <- paste0("count ~ log_scoops + ", var)
  
  model <- try(
    glm.nb(as.formula(formula_str),
           data = analysis_data),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  cat("\n----------------------------------\n")
  cat("Variable:", var, "\n")
  
  if (!inherits(model, "try-error")) {
    print(summary(model)$coefficients)
    cat("AIC:", AIC(model), "\n")
    print(anova(nb_null, model, test = "LRT"))
  }
}
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# TEMPERATURE × SIZE CLASS INTERACTION
# ==========================================
# Additive temperature model (no interaction)
nb_temp_additive <- glm.nb(
  count ~ log_scoops +
          water_temp_c +
          size_class +
          location +
          year,
  data = analysis_data,
  control = glm.control(maxit = 200)
)
# ----------------------------------
# Temperature × Size Interaction
# ----------------------------------

nb_temp_size <- glm.nb(
  count ~ log_scoops +
          water_temp_c * size_class +
          location +
          year,
  data = analysis_data,
  control = glm.control(maxit = 200)
)

summary(nb_temp_size)


# ----------------------------------
# Likelihood Ratio Test
# ----------------------------------

cat("\n--- Temperature × Size Interaction Test ---\n")
print(AIC(nb_temp_additive, nb_temp_size))
print(anova(nb_temp_additive, nb_temp_size, test = "LRT"))


# ==========================================
# EXTRACT SIZE-SPECIFIC TEMPERATURE SLOPES
# ==========================================

coefs <- coef(nb_temp_size)
vc <- vcov(nb_temp_size)

sizes <- levels(analysis_data$size_class)

temp_size_results <- lapply(sizes, function(s) {
  
  cvec <- rep(0, length(coefs))
  names(cvec) <- names(coefs)
  
  # Base temperature effect
  cvec["water_temp_c"] <- 1
  
  # Interaction term (if not reference level)
  term <- paste0("water_temp_c:size_class", s)
  if (term %in% names(coefs)) {
    cvec[term] <- 1
  }
  
  log_beta <- sum(cvec * coefs)
  se <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(cvec) %*% vc %*% cvec))
  
  IRR <- exp(log_beta)
  
  data.frame(
    size_class = s,
    percent_change_per_1C = (1 - IRR) * 100,
    lower = (1 - exp(log_beta + 1.96 * se)) * 100,
    upper = (1 - exp(log_beta - 1.96 * se)) * 100
  )
})

temp_size_results <- do.call(rbind, temp_size_results)

cat("\n--- Percent Change in Abundance per 1°C Increase ---\n")
print(temp_size_results)
```

```{r}
     xlab = "Fitted values",

     type = "h",
     main = "Cook's Distance",
     ylab = "Influence")

# ---- 5. Temporal Autocorrelation Check ----

# Order data by date and attach Pearson residuals
analysis_data_ordered <- analysis_data %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(
    pearson_resid = residuals(nb_final, type = "pearson")
  )
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# MODEL-BASED DEMOGRAPHIC RESTRUCTURING
# ==========================================

# ---- Get fitted values + SE on link scale ----
pred_vals <- predict(
  nb_final,
  newdata = analysis_data,
  type = "link",
  se.fit = TRUE
)

plot_data <- analysis_data
plot_data$link_fit <- pred_vals$fit
plot_data$link_se  <- pred_vals$se.fit

# ---- Aggregate on link scale ----
model_year <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(year, size_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_link = mean(link_fit, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_se = sd(link_fit) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    fit = exp(mean_link),
    lwr = exp(mean_link - 1.96 * mean_se),
    upr = exp(mean_link + 1.96 * mean_se),
    year_num = as.numeric(year)
  )

# ---- Disturbance band spanning 2023–2024 ----
disturbance <- data.frame(
  xmin = 3,
  xmax = 4,
  ymin = min(model_year$lwr),
  ymax = max(model_year$upr)
)

# ---- Plot ----
ggplot(model_year,
       aes(x = year_num,
           y = fit,
           color = size_class,
           fill = size_class,
           group = size_class)) +
  
  geom_rect(
    data = disturbance,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    aes(xmin = xmin,
        xmax = xmax,
        ymin = ymin,
        ymax = ymax),
    fill = "red",
    alpha = 0.08
  ) +
  
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lwr,
        ymax = upr),
    alpha = 0.18,
    color = NA
  ) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  
  # Disturbance label centered in band
  annotate("text",
           x = 3.5,
           y = max(model_year$upr) * 1.15,
           label = "Nourishment",
           color = "red",
           size = 5,
           fontface = "bold",
           hjust = 0.5) +
  # 99.4% modeled decline annotation
annotate("text",
         x = 3.5,
         y = max(model_year$upr) * 0.6,
         label = "99.4% Decline \n 2021 → 2024",
         color = "red",
         size = 5,
         fontface = "bold",
         hjust = 0.5) +
  
  scale_y_log10() +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:length(levels(model_year$year)),
    labels = levels(model_year$year)
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  
  labs(
    y = "Model-Fitted Abundance (log scale)",
    x = "Year",
    color = "Size Class",
    fill  = "Size Class",
    title = "Model-Based Temporal Trend"
  )
```

```{r}
  summarise(total_fit = sum(fit), .groups = "drop")

resistance_2024 <- total_model$total_fit[total_model$year == "2024"] /
                   total_model$total_fit[total_model$year == "2021"]

recovery_2025 <- total_model$total_fit[total_model$year == "2025"] /
                 total_model$total_fit[total_model$year == "2024"]

cat("Resistance (2024 / 2021):", round(resistance_2024, 3), "\n")
cat("Recovery (2025 / 2024):", round(recovery_2025, 2), "\n\n")

# ----------------------------------
# 2. Model-Adjusted 2024 Decline
# ----------------------------------

coef_summary <- summary(nb_final)$coefficients
beta_2024 <- coef_summary["year2024", "Estimate"]
se_2024   <- coef_summary["year2024", "Std. Error"]

IRR_2024  <- exp(beta_2024)
lower     <- exp(beta_2024 - 1.96 * se_2024)
upper     <- exp(beta_2024 + 1.96 * se_2024)

cat("2024 IRR vs 2021:", round(IRR_2024, 3), "\n")
cat("95% CI:", round(lower, 3), "-", round(upper, 3), "\n")
cat("Percent Decline:", round((1 - IRR_2024) * 100, 1), "%\n\n")

# ----------------------------------
# 3. Structural Reset (Cramer's V)
# ----------------------------------

structure_table <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year, size_class) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = size_class,
              values_from = total,
              values_fill = 0)

mat <- as.matrix(structure_table[,-1])
rownames(mat) <- structure_table$year

# Global V
chisq_all <- chisq.test(mat)
X2_all <- chisq_all$statistic
N_all  <- sum(mat)
k_all  <- min(nrow(mat)-1, ncol(mat)-1)
V_all  <- sqrt(X2_all / (N_all * k_all))

# Targeted reset (2022 vs 2025)
mat_22_25 <- mat[c("2022","2025"), ]
chisq_22_25 <- chisq.test(mat_22_25)
X2_22_25 <- chisq_22_25$statistic
N_22_25  <- sum(mat_22_25)
k_22_25  <- min(nrow(mat_22_25)-1, ncol(mat_22_25)-1)
V_22_25  <- sqrt(X2_22_25 / (N_22_25 * k_22_25))

cat("Cramer's V (All Years):", round(V_all, 2), "\n")
cat("Cramer's V (2022 vs 2025):", round(V_22_25, 2), "\n\n")

# ----------------------------------
# 4. Altered State (Mean Size Shift)
# ----------------------------------

size_data$size_numeric <- ifelse(size_data$size_class == "Small (2mm)", 2,
                          ifelse(size_data$size_class == "Medium (6mm)", 6, 12))

state_df <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abundance = mean(count),
    mean_size = sum(count * size_numeric) / sum(count),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mean_2021 <- state_df$mean_size[state_df$year == "2021"]
mean_2025 <- state_df$mean_size[state_df$year == "2025"]

cat("Mean Size 2021:", round(mean_2021, 2), "mm\n")
cat("Mean Size 2025:", round(mean_2025, 2), "mm\n")

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("END CORE METRICS\n")
cat("==============================\n")
```

```{r}
library(scales)

# ---------------------------------------------
# Data
# ---------------------------------------------

coef_summary <- summary(nb_final)$coefficients

effect_time <- data.frame(
  Year = c(2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025),
  Estimate = c(
    1,
    exp(coef_summary["year2022","Estimate"]),
    exp(coef_summary["year2023","Estimate"]),
    exp(coef_summary["year2024","Estimate"]),
    exp(coef_summary["year2025","Estimate"])
  ),
  point_col = c(
    "#F7D000",      # 2021
    "#E69F00",    # 2022
    "#F7D000",    # 2023
    "red",        # 2024
    "#F7D000"     # 2025
  )
)

# ---------------------------------------------
# Create gradient segments
# ---------------------------------------------

gradient_segments <- data.frame()

for(i in 1:(nrow(effect_time)-1)) {
  
  n <- 100  # smoothness
  
  x_vals <- seq(effect_time$Year[i],
                effect_time$Year[i+1],
                length.out = n)
  
 log_y_vals <- seq(log(effect_time$Estimate[i]),
                  log(effect_time$Estimate[i+1]),
                  length.out = n)

y_vals <- exp(log_y_vals)

  col_vals <- colorRampPalette(
    c(effect_time$point_col[i],
      effect_time$point_col[i+1])
  )(n)
  
  temp <- data.frame(
    x = x_vals[-n],
    y = y_vals[-n],
    xend = x_vals[-1],
    yend = y_vals[-1],
    col = col_vals[-n]
  )
  
  gradient_segments <- rbind(gradient_segments, temp)
}

# ---------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------------------------

ggplot() +
  
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = 2023,
           xmax = 2024,
           ymin = 0.001,
           ymax = 2,
           fill = "red",
           alpha = 0.05) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1,
             linetype = "dashed",
             linewidth = 1.3,
             color = "black") +
  annotate("text",
         x = 2021.1,
         y = 1.3,
         label = "Baseline year",
         color = "#E69F00",
         fontface = "bold",
         size = 6,
         hjust = 0) +
  
  # TRUE gradient segments
geom_segment(data = gradient_segments,
             aes(x = x, y = y,
                 xend = xend, yend = yend,
                 color = col),
             linewidth = 4.5,
             show.legend = FALSE) +

scale_color_identity() +
  
  # Points (unchanged)
  geom_point(data = effect_time,
             aes(x = Year, y = Estimate),
             size = c(8,8,8,10,8),
             color = effect_time$point_col) +
  
  annotate("text",
           x = 2024 - 0.5,
           y = effect_time$Estimate[4] * 0.5,
           label = "Nourishment Event \n 99.4% decline",
           color = "red",
           fontface = "bold",
           size = 6) +
  
  annotate("text",
           x = 2024.85,
           y = effect_time$Estimate[5],
           label = "Juvenile rebound",
           color = "#CC8400",
           fontface = "bold",
           size = 5.5,
           hjust = 1) +
  
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2021:2025) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 24) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Relative Abundance (vs 2021)",
    title = "Disturbance Trajectory in Atlantic Mole Crab Abundance"
  )
```
